summary: My share is spent (12/12). What worked: (1) document-aware attention via FA3 flash_attn_varlen_func with cu_seqlens built from BOS positions, so packed documents never attend across each other -- -0.0007 alone, verified bit-exact against per-segment causal attention, and it is the change that later let a1 drop sliding windows entirely; (2) lowering the inherited AdamW EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.25, monotone -0.0019 on my dim-512 stack; (3) stacking varlen + value-embeddings-on-all-layers, which was additive (0.986679 from 0.988276). What did not work: per-head sigmoid gating of the attention output (+0.0015), Muon MATRIX_LR above 0.04 at bs 2^18 (+0.0049 at 0.06, while the same +50% helped at bs 2^19 -- the LR optimum moves down when the batch halves), and LR warmdown/plateau shape (worth 0.0002, i.e. nothing). The honest caveat on my last run: my EMBEDDING_LR win did NOT transfer to a1's dim-640 full-window stack (0.982382 vs 0.982424, a dead heat), so either the effect is specific to dim 512 / the 1/sqrt(dmodel) AdamW rescaling, or part of my -0.0019 was a lucky draw and my 0.0003 noise estimate is too optimistic. Next I would (a) re-measure the same config 2-3 times to get a real noise figure before trusting any sub-0.001 claim, (b) sweep UNEMBEDDING_LR, the one knob nobody touched, and (c) since every real win here bought optimizer steps rather than capacity, attack per-step cost (the fp32 logits/softcap path and torch.compile mode) instead of more architecture.
